001terminal-portfolio ↗web / v0.6

A personal home on the web, inspired by the text-first feel of Advent of Code. Built with a near-black terminal background, monospace typography, and green links.

Includes keyboard-accessible tabs, project filters, expandable notes, five color themes with Matrix green as the default, and an optional command prompt for navigating the site.

stack: HTML · CSS · JavaScript · Sites hosting

status: first version deployed; growing with my work
